findings.label: _safe_redirect_url open-redirect guard is untested
findings.detail: No test exercises next=//evil.com, next=https://evil.com, or a valid local path through the login/callback flow. A regression in the guard would re-open open-redirect silently. Add unit tests for _safe_redirect_url directly, covering the reject-//host, reject-full-URL, and accept-local-path cases.

findings.label: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE comment is misleading
findings.detail: The config comment claims the value is resolved at startup; it actually resolves at class-definition (import) time. No functional bug in the current single-class pattern, but it is a latent trap for subclasses. Correct the comment or move the assignment into init_app.

findings.label: handleSignOut silently swallows 403 from CSRF guard
findings.detail: The try/catch in Layout.tsx is intentionally best-effort, but it means a 403 (e.g. from a non-browser client omitting Origin) causes refetch() to run and the UI to show as signed-out while the server session persists. Document the Origin requirement in the API contract.

findings.label: _safe_redirect_url not exercised through the full callback flow
findings.detail: The oauth_next → redirect path in google_callback is never tested end-to-end. A test that mocks _exchange_code_for_tokens and _decode_id_token and verifies the post-login redirect target would close this gap.
